# Module 3 — Radioactivity

## Decay Constant

### Q1
Stem: A nuclide has a half-life of 10.0 days. What is λ?
A. 0.0693 day^-1
B. 6.93 day^-1
C. 14.4 days
D. 0.693 day
Answer: A
Objective: I.10
Why: λ = 0.693 / 10.0 = 0.0693 day^-1. 6.93 moves the decimal.

## Common Radioisotopes

### Q1
Stem: The HDR source and its half-life are Ir-192 and which value?
A. Ir-192, 73.8 days
B. Co-60, 73.8 days
C. Cs-137, 73.8 days
D. I-125, 73.8 days
Answer: A
Objective: I.7
Why: Ir-192 is the HDR nuclide, half-life 73.8 days.

### Q2
Stem: Gamma emission from a nucleus changes Z and A by which amounts?
A. Z down by 2 and A down by 4
B. Z up by 1 and A unchanged
C. Z unchanged and A unchanged
D. Z down by 1 and A down by 1
Answer: C
Objective: I.1
Why: A gamma ray removes excitation energy. The nuclide stays the same species.
